children: Kinetic Engineering, the flagship entity of the Kinetic Group, is making an additional investment of approximately Rs 57 crore towards expansion and growth of the company. Of this, around Rs 17 crore will be directed towards Capex, while Rs 40 crore will be invested in expansion of its electric two-wheeler segment. The investment is by way of last tranche of conversion of 44,51,000 warrants issued to promoters in March 2025.

The renewed investment comes at a time of growing traction for the brand on the ground. Kinetic has signed LOIs with 150+ dealers across the country, of which more than 60 are already operational, backed by 3S (Sales, Service and Spares) facilities. This growing network is building a distribution ecosystem to support the company’s expansion plans.

With this momentum, Kinetic is setting its sights on entering the top 10 electric vehicle brands in the country. Electric two-wheeler penetration is expected to reach approximately 26 per cent by FY 2030 as per Kearney report making the current market size of 1.8mn to 7mn, creating a significant opportunity for Kinetic to expand its footprint, strengthen its market presence and scale its business in the years ahead.
A key part of this growth strategy is the Kinetic DX and DX+, which, as per the company, are gaining strong traction in the market.
Reflecting the growing confidence of its own stakeholders, Kinetic's promoter shareholding has risen from 50 per cent to 69.27 per cent over the last four years.

Commenting on the development, Ajinkya Firodia, Vice Chairman & Managing Director, Kinetic Engineering Limited, said, “Our auto-components business is seeing a healthy pipeline of new orders, which will support growth and help us work towards our target of improving EBITDA margins to around 12 per cent. At the same time, the response to our Kinetic DX electric scooter has been encouraging, giving us confidence to expand our presence across markets.”
